task.question: What is the highest recorded temperature in Germany during the 2026 European heatwaves?
task.evidence: 27 June — 2026 European heatwaves: The highest recorded temperature in Germany is taken in Möckern-Drewitz, measuring 41.5 °C (106.7 °F).

answer:
Based on the search results I found, the highest recorded temperature in Germany during the 2026 European heatwaves was **41.8 °C (107.2 °F)**, which was measured on 27 June in Drewitz, part of Möckern, in the northern part of Saxony-Anhalt.

This was followed by another record of 41.7 °C (107.1 °F) recorded on 28 June in Coschen, close to the Polish border.

FINAL: 41.8 °C (107.2 °F) in Drewitz, Saxony-Anhalt on 27 June 2026
